index.intro: Manage models, integrated systems and incidents. Replaces manual editing of .env with full control through the interface.
index.managedOn: Every enabled model in the registry is a candidate for the agent (DA-72); destination and key come from the registry (fail-closed).
index.modelsText: Manage keys and prices per origin

models.copied: Effective configuration copied to the clipboard!
models.diffBanner: Database values differ from .env — fields that require a restart: LLM_REGISTRY_DB, LLM_PROVIDER, LLM_ROUTE, LLM_FALLBACK_PROVIDER. The others (sovereignty, authentication, rule engine, timeouts, budget and routing) apply at runtime.
models.effectiveIntro: Combines database overrides with .env values. Sensitive values are masked.
models.registeredIntro: Manage keys, prices, usage limits and the parameters the agent uses to choose the model.
models.routingIntro: Used by the agent to choose the model in managed mode (LLM_REGISTRY_DB). Empty = derived from the origin or unrestricted. The origin capability is the ceiling: here you can only restrict it.
models.runtimeIntro: Infrastructure overrides — they replace .env variables at runtime. Without a database: shows the current .env value (read-only).
models.setDefault: Set as default for this origin
models.simIntro: Runs the same decision the agent makes (Policy Engine, DA-66/72) for a new diagnosis, without calling the LLM.
models.simNone: no eligible model — the diagnosis would fail (503)
models.simSummary: Mode: {{mode}} · available budget {{budget}} · weights cost {{cost}} / latency {{latency}}

usage.intro: Track token usage per model with monthly limit and cost in USD.
usage.percentHelp: Percentage = (tokens in+out) / monthly limit set in Models. Without a limit, the percentage stays blank.

users.createdSent: Created — token sent by real e-mail
users.intro: Two-step activation: e-mail token → phone code → sign in. Without SMTP/SMS configured (out-of-band), the token/code shows up below — deliver it to the user through a channel you control.

web.title: Approved web search sources (DA-57)
